protocol.native_timing: Date.now immediately before returning a case until Date.now at the beginning of the next functions.exec call submitting a choice.
protocol.mcts_timing: Date.now immediately before route_mcts invocation until its promise resolves.
protocol.input_equivalence: Same deterministic three-step reward paths in both arms. Codex sees compact named paths; route_mcts receives the expanded graph and the same paths in root tool descriptions. Serialization differs.
limitations: Different transport/dispatch envelopes; neither arm exposes pure reasoning/compute time.
One growing Codex session; exact model and reasoning setting not independently captured.
Codex authored scenario families before timing, so this is not a held-out or blind study.
New multi-step workloads; results cannot isolate the cost of MCTS relative to the earlier ordinary-route benchmark.
Simple deterministic trees with branching only at root; not stochastic environments or deeper branching.
MCTS confidence is a visit share, not calibrated correctness probability.
Returned policy_evaluations counts router evaluations, not verified network requests or successful Jev responses.
Graph preparation and simulator development costs are outside the timer.
Installed MCP server revision is not independently verified against the checkout.
